chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!

key_terms.لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ: For the deniers, those who rejected the truth
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe or destruction, a cry of anguish in hell
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wail' for the deniers in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat (77:30) underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for the disbelievers, linking their denial to the specific context of the Prophet's message being rejected by the Quraysh. The term 'Wail' signifies a deep, abiding sorrow and destruction, emphasizing that the punishment is not merely physical but a spiritual consequence of rejecting the truth (Haqq). This serves as a warning to believers to remain steadfast in their conviction despite societal opposition.
